description.from: The whole programme. A public benchmark of System 1 decision models (text in, typed question, a probability per option, no reasoning): causal counterfactuals on real text with control floors, reported in the decision's own currency, replayed offline from a committed answer record. Three strands: the harness and its record, the studies that produce the numbers, and the engines it covers.
description.to: The whole programme. A public benchmark of System 1 decision models (text in, typed question, a probability per option, no reasoning): causal counterfactuals on real text with control floors, reported in the decision's own currency, replayed offline from a committed answer record. Owns the harness and the studies; the engines it covers are tracked in the sibling initiative Expand model coverage (BD-250c97).
